---
title: "Short Vegetation Table"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  plot_numbers: ""
  site_unit: ""
  project_id: ""
  group_by: "layer"
  order_by: "species"
  presence_min: 0
  cover_min: 0
  value_limit: 0
  avg_type: "mean"
  show_common: "none"
  apply_lumping: false
  constancy_format: false
  display_value: "standard"
  colour_greater: 5
  gray_greater: 65
  apply_theme: true
  report_title: "Short Vegetation Table"
  project_root: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

utils_candidates <- c(
  file.path(dirname(tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")), "_vpro_report_utils.R"),
  file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""), "reports", "_vpro_report_utils.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "reports", "_vpro_report_utils.R")
)
utils_candidates <- utils_candidates[nzchar(utils_candidates)]
utils_path <- utils_candidates[file.exists(utils_candidates)][1]
if (!nzchar(utils_path)) stop("Unable to locate reports/_vpro_report_utils.R")
source(utils_path)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
root_dir <- vpro_project_root(params$project_root)
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_lumping.R"))
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_path <- tryCatch(
    normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    error = function(e) params$db_path
  )
}
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("vw_USysAllVeg", "Sample_SU", "Sample_Lump", "LayerCode")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_file <- file.path(parquet_dir, "lists_USysAllSpecs.parquet")
  if (file.exists(list_file)) {
    dbExecute(
      con,
      sprintf("CREATE TABLE VLists.USysAllSpecs AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", gsub("'", "''", list_file))
    )
  }
} else {
  con <- vpro_duckdb_connect(db_path, root_dir = root_dir, read_only = TRUE, attach_lists = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(params$plot_number, params$plot_numbers)
veg <- load_veg_report_data(
  con,
  plot_numbers = plots,
  site_unit = trimws(params$site_unit),
  project_id = trimws(params$project_id),
  apply_lumping = isTRUE(params$apply_lumping)
)

summary <- summarize_veg_report(
  veg,
  group_by = if (isTRUE(params$constancy_format)) "lifeform" else params$group_by,
  order_by = params$order_by,
  presence_min = params$presence_min,
  cover_min = params$cover_min,
  value_limit = params$value_limit,
  avg_type = params$avg_type,
  show_common = params$show_common,
  display_value = params$display_value
)

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# `r params$report_title`

`r if (isTRUE(params$constancy_format)) "Vegetation Table - Constancy Format" else "Vegetation Table"`

`r if (isTRUE(params$apply_lumping)) "Lumping applied" else ""`

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(summary) > 0) {
  constancy_format <- isTRUE(params$constancy_format)
  display_mode <- if (!is.null(params$display_value) && nzchar(params$display_value)) {
    tolower(params$display_value)
  } else {
    "standard"
  }
  if (constancy_format) {
    view <- data.frame(
      Group = summary$group_label,
      Species = summary$species_label,
      Constancy = round(summary$presence_pct, 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else if (display_mode != "standard") {
    view <- data.frame(
      Group = summary$group_label,
      Species = summary$species_label,
      Display = summary$display_value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    view <- data.frame(
      Group = summary$group_label,
      Species = summary$species_label,
      Presence = round(summary$presence_pct, 1),
      MeanCover = round(summary$mean_cover, 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (params$show_common != "none") {
    if (constancy_format) {
      view <- cbind(view[, c("Group", "Species")], Common = summary$common_label, view[, "Constancy", drop = FALSE])
    } else if (display_mode != "standard") {
      view <- cbind(view[, c("Group", "Species")], Common = summary$common_label, view[, "Display", drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      view <- cbind(view[, c("Group", "Species")], Common = summary$common_label, view[, c("Presence", "MeanCover")])
    }
  }

  apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
  colour_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$colour_greater))
  gray_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$gray_greater))
  if (apply_theme && nrow(view) > 0) {
    num_cols <- names(view)[vapply(view, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
      style_numeric <- function(vec) {
        num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vec))
        labels <- ifelse(is.na(num), "", as.character(vec))
        vapply(seq_along(num), function(i) {
          value <- num[[i]]
          label <- labels[[i]]
          if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(label)) return("")
          bg <- ""
          if (!is.na(gray_greater) && value >= gray_greater) {
            bg <- "#e6e6e6"
          } else if (!is.na(colour_greater) && value >= colour_greater) {
            bg <- "#f9e27d"
          }
          if (nzchar(bg)) cell_spec(label, background = bg) else label
        }, character(1))
      }
      for (col_name in num_cols) {
        view[[col_name]] <- style_numeric(view[[col_name]])
      }
    }
  }

  kbl(view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No vegetation data found.")
}
```
